Project Instructions
This is the marketing website for Made by CKT, a UK app company. The maintainer is a capable beginner developer.
Rules
Keep responses and command output concise.
Prefer the simplest solution and smallest reasonable change. Don't refactor unrelated code or add unnecessary dependencies, abstractions or configuration.
Reuse existing project patterns. Prefer editing content over code when possible.
Use TypeScript for new code.
Before structural changes, check PROJECT_GUIDE.md and relevant files.
Don't modify deployment, GitHub Actions or infrastructure unless requested or required.
If intent is genuinely unclear, ask one concise question.
Explain technical changes briefly in plain English.
Minimise investigation: start with the most likely file, read only what is needed, don't inspect unrelated files, and stop once you have enough information to act.
Don't run commands just to confirm things you already know. Minimise command output.
If a task is simple for the user to do manually but would require significant investigation or token usage, give exact copy/paste instructions instead.
Use the cheapest capable model; only use a more capable model when necessary.
Don't run the project build unless explicitly requested.
Content editing safety
When changing visible text:
Change only the requested text.
Preserve surrounding HTML/Astro structure, classes, styling and SVGs.
Don't replace/remove whole sections for small text changes.
Read enough surrounding code to identify the exact text node.
Inspect the affected area after markup changes.
Tell the user to run the build themselves.
